description: Run Valuation - selection screen. Test Run decides simulate vs commit, same trap as TBB1.

companyCode.title: Company Code
companyCode.note: From/to pair - nth 0 is the 'from' selection field.

transaction.title: Financial Transaction
transaction.note: From/to pair - nth 0 is the 'from' selection field, used to scope the run to one deal.

valuationClass.title: Valuation Class
valuationClass.note: Coded value, e.g. '0005' (Valuation Area 001) = Short Term. Read from the field's own F4 value help, never guessed - see discover-tpm-valuation-class.spec.ts.

keyDate.title: Key Date for Valuation
keyDate.note: Defaults to today. Set to the deal's month-end key date, not its term start - the same key date TPM44 ran with, so both value/accrue as of the same point.

valuationCategory.title: Valuation Category
valuationCategory.note: MANDATORY. Defaults to the placeholder '  ?', and TPM1 refuses to execute without it - 'Make an entry in mandatory field "Valuation Category"'. The refusal leaves the selection screen on display looking untouched, so a run that never executed reads as a clean pass unless the caller asserts on the protocol.

testRun.note: Defaults to ON, discovered via a [role=checkbox] dump (discover-tpm-checkboxes.spec.ts) - dumpScreen cannot see it. Left alone, a 'post' simulates, reports success and writes nothing, same trap as TBB1's M0:46:::31:5.

execute.note: F8. This only SELECTS positions - it lands on 'Display Selected Treasury Positions for Valuation' and posts nothing. See runValuation, which must then press runValuation below.

runValuation.note: 'Run the Valuation of the Displayed Treasury Positions (F8)', on the positions screen that execute lands on - NOT the selection screen. This is the step that actually values; without it TPM1 reports no error, shows the deal as 'Valuation Allowed', and has written nothing.
